title: Xing USP: A Cross-Family Semantic Contract for Information Extraction and Intent-Slot Parsing
abstract: arXiv:2610.34343v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Structured semantic parsing is typically judged by whether the correct category is assigned, which leaves value recovery and instance-level associations unexamined: a system may recognize an event yet bind an argument to the wrong instance, or identify an intent yet supply an incorrect slot value. We present USP, a cross-family semantic contract that represents categories, fields, values, and instance associations through a common interface for named-entity recognition, relation extraction, event extraction, and intent-slot parsing. The contract is paired with five diagnostic matching views---category agreement, field recognition, field-value pairing, instance-bound assignment, and complete-instance recovery---that ask distinct questions about the same output. translated_title: Xing USP：面向信息抽取与意图-槽位解析的跨家族语义契约
translated_abstract: 结构化语义解析通常以是否分配了正确的类别来评判，这使得值恢复与实例级关联未被检验：一个系统可能识别出了事件，却将参数绑定到错误的实例；或者识别出了意图，却提供了错误的槽位值。我们提出了USP，一个跨家族语义契约，它通过统一接口表示类别、字段、值和实例关联，涵盖命名实体识别、关系抽取、事件抽取和意图-槽位解析四类任务。该契约配套五种诊断性匹配视图——类别一致性、字段识别、字段-值配对、实例绑定赋值和完整实例恢复——它们针对同一输出提出不同的问题。利用该契约，我们将61个数据集规范化为具有共享模式、提示和匹配规则的统一语料库，并在固定测试子集上比较了六个模型。
tldr: 本文提出USP跨家族语义契约，通过统一接口将命名实体识别、关系抽取、事件抽取和意图-槽位解析整合表示，并将61个数据集规范化为统一语料库，借助五种诊断匹配视图超越单纯类别判定来评估值恢复与实例级关联能力。
en_tdlr: USP is proposed as a cross-family semantic contract that unifies NER, relation extraction, event extraction, and intent-slot parsing through a common interface, normalizing 61 datasets into a unified corpus evaluated via five diagnostic matching views that assess value recovery and instance-level associations beyond mere category assignment.
